responsibility: This generator produces the insn-output metadata tables that describe every instruction and expander recognized from the machine description. It scans operands, predicates, constraints, alternatives, templates, and generator argument counts for DEFINE_INSN, DEFINE_PEEPHOLE, DEFINE_EXPAND, and constraint definitions, interns operand descriptors into shared tables, validates constraint structure, and emits the insn_data, operand data, and get_insn_name support used by recognizers, output routines, and optab-driven expansion.
